fact: On interviews held between September 2020 and March 2021, the World Bank brief states that South Sudan's DHIS2 implementation is accelerating but has yet to involve a significant fraction (at least 20 percent) of the country's health facilities, that County Health Departments are designated the linchpins of the rollout and in charge of DHIS2 reporting, and that monitoring activities are highly dependent on donor funding.
title: Heath Service Monitoring in South Sudan: Overview of Approaches and Arrangements. Policy Brief 1/5
